## Confirmed fixture defects and correction

1. The late source-failure wrapper was installed while the mutating-peer fixture was being prepared. It intercepted peer get_packet calls. On combined brief it consumed the allowed first read on the peer, then made parent capture fail before the diagnostic branch. Delivery failed during peer enqueue validation. Corrected by keying the hook to the exact candidate packet id after each real bounded read, leaving every other packet healthy. The original branch still pays full content validation before the intentional fault.
2. The independent-request peer used the candidate's already-claimed seat. The real queue correctly refused a second simultaneous claim with QueueBusy. It now uses the other managed fixture seat (API for a CLI candidate, the original CLI seat for an API candidate), retaining both original claim ownership and independent request progress.

Added two functional regression controls with the candidate ALREADY CLAIMED and the source hook active during peer setup. Both were observed ERROR before the fixes (ArtifactUnavailable in validate_enqueue; QueueBusy in claim). After correction:21 harness controls OK2.004s. This is tool-only; all four product hashes remain the frozen measured values. The former19 controls did not cover these interactions, and those gaps caused this invalid attempt.

No automatic new timing run follows these fixes. Send the corrected tool/doc pin and these complete receipts to the reviewer for a recovery ruling. The ten DESIGN samples remain valid evidence on e4acae6; the31-row attempt remains retained alongside them. Remaining79 service samples and all later gate groups were not run. No exclusion, machine attribution, threshold adjustment, source optimization, R3/operator/capacity/activation or push.
